question: Muscovite, pegmatite and biotite are ores of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**mica.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Muscovite, pegmatite and biotite **are ores of mica. 
 
• Muscovite is a hydrated phyllosilicate mineral of aluminium and potassium with formula KAl2(AlSi3O10)(FOH)2, or (KF)2(Al2O3)3(SiO2)6(H2O).
 
• Pegmatite is an igneous rock and is composed of quartz, felds
